blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — A magnitude 5 earthquake jolted Occidental Mindoro on Wednesday morning, with the strongest reported shaking at Intensity IV in the towns of Mamburao and Sablayan, according to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs). The earthquake struck at 9:34 a.m. and was recorded at a depth of 10 kilometers, with the epicenter located at 13.19°N, 120.38°E, or about 23 kilometers southwest of Mamburao, Phivolcs said.
